about: Test results the agentic test-and-fix workflow compares new runs against. Rebuilt by tools/agentic/test_baseline.py build; a class note says why its failures are known.

tScenarios.label: tScenarios
tScenarios.note: Full run of 2026-11-11 on the layout-cleanup models (before the direct-links top level); every failure was already there before the layout work (work/layout/report.md). Most compare against old saved results in which the robot does not move; S4 no longer waits on implement-ready since the Nov 12 fix (switch 2 in S3 and S4), but still fails: the full rerun of Nov 13 (work/agentic/logs/20261112_1758_s4_full.log) pauses for NAV_DEGRADED in the rows, then for PLANNER_FAIL from 464 s, coverage 0.16; S3, S7wet and S7temp were never run. Nov 14, after the S4 fixes D66-D69 (work/agentic/logs/20261114_s4fix_s4_full.log): S4 completes in 13.7 min; it still fails only on S4.xte_max (0.252 m against 0.15 m, at the row entries after the headland turns). 2026-11-15 (critfix): testS6a/testS6b also miss the 1.5 s standstill criterion (1.61 s), a threshold coincidence (minimum 0.0100 vs 0.0101 m/s at +1.12 s, the same speed tail before and after; integration report); testS2 fails on v_mean and the T-INT-04 pitch as on 11-14.

t_perception.label: t_perception
t_perception.note: Full run of 2026-11-11 on the layout-cleanup models (before the direct-links top level); every failure was already there before the layout work (work/layout/report.md). tCompiledTiming fails on time on this laptop (44.3 ms against 40 ms); tFull3dCloud2Scan and tSM00_ScanMatchTiming fail; tCodegen is left out. On 2026-11-14 (nav round 2) tCompiledTiming passed at 26.2 ms, against 44.3 ms before, while the change adds matcher work, so it stays listed as failing: the time depends on the load of the PC. 2026-11-15 (critfix): tPER05_TebVfh fails because Windows Code Integrity now blocks MATLAB from loading the unsigned accelerator MEX work/tb_per_tebvfh_msf.mexw64 (environment, a Windows security setting that only the user may change); its bench does not use protectiveStop.
